data.name: Blank Slate
data.detailed_description:
You lost everything. So you became someone else.

A fake identity. A few suspicious businesses. And a city full of people who need things they can't ask for openly.

By day you run your shops. Smile at the inspector. Nothing to see here. By night you run everything else — robberies, organ deals, and operations the city pretends don't exist.

🪪 Hack → Forge → Sell
Pull real identity data from police databases using your phone. Build convincing fake IDs. Sell them to customers who can't ask questions. Quality, risk, and price are your problem.

🏪 Cover → Expand → Dominate
Start with one shady storefront. Grow into a multi-business empire across the city. Every shop is a cover. The bigger you get, the harder it is to look clean.

🚓 Bribe → Evade → Survive
Police inspections don't announce themselves. Suspicion builds quietly until it doesn't. Bribe the right people. One careless move and everything disappears — including you.

💰 Launder → Reinvest → Repeat
Dirty money becomes clean businesses. Clean businesses fund dirtier operations. Upgrade your shops, automate your covers, go deeper underground.

In this city, looking clean is the dirtiest trick of all.

Minimum:

  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 TI or Radeon RX 570
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 5600 XT
